method.legacy_projection: format_aci_result on the envelope with the compact `hash` removed (== the pre-TF-0045 client projection)
method.current_projection: format_aci_result on the envelope as returned by the current binary
method.tokens: len(projected_text) // 4 (same estimate the live bench records)
method.reproducible_call: a frozen call is counted only when replaying it through the current binary reproduces the exact token count the stored live run recorded, under the projection that run actually used (`current` once the compact-digest client shipped, `legacy` before it); calls that read run-produced state (audit log, ERR.txt, out/...) fail that test and are listed with both numbers
method.caveat: client-side envelope effect on a frozen call set; it is NOT a model-behaviour measurement and says nothing about whether the model would choose different calls
